plan.notes: Official 'Finance' BSBA degree map, Harrison College of Business and Computing (39-hr major + 30-hr Business Administration Core + 21-hr support courses, no minor required; grade of C required in each core and support course). All 8 semester grids transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (13/15/17/18/14/15/15/15); grand total 122cr (degree requires a minimum of 120cr). OR-choice groups transcribed at first-listed option. Blanket prerequisite (all 100/200-level core and support courses are prerequisite to all 300-level business core and major courses) and GPA milestones (2.25 overall; 2.25 overall + 2.25 major in years 3-4) documented here, not per-course. Guide based on the 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog; retrieved 2026-10-09.
